About the job

Network Engineer

Onsite - Plano, TX

1 year contract Includes Paid Holidays + 15 days of accrued PTO


Responsibilities

  • Configure and maintain Aruba wireless hardware including Mobility Conductor, Mobility Controllers, Access Points, and switches.
  • Execute Wi-Worker1 RF (Radio Frequency) planning, site surveys, and tuning to ensure optimal coverage, signal quality, and minimal interference.
  • Implement and monitor robust network security measures, including 802.1X, RADIUS/EAP-TLS authentication, and Role-Based Access Control (ClearPass)


Requirements

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in network engineering and administration.
  • Experience in the implementation and operation of wireless networks is a plus. (Cisco or Aruba)
  • Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver excellent customer service and build strong professional relationships.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Strong documentation and organizational skills.
  • Prior network administration experience is highly preferred.
  • Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) or equivalent certification is a plus.


Compensation & Benefits

The pay range for this position is $31 – $36 per hour, depending on experience, skills, and location.


Full benefits are available, including:

  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
  • 401(k) plan
  • Parental Leave
  • Additional benefits


Pay range is $31 - $36 per hour with full benefits available, including paid time off, medical/dental/vision/life insurance, 401K, parental leave, and more. Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. Pay is based on several factors including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.
